<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/process"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

Lists each process with its user, state, CPU and memory, its command line and when it started, through gohai: from /proc on Linux and from ps on macOS. A process that stops while the list is read is not in it.
